messages:
lina: Quick heads-up — we hit a Dedicated capacity wall for the sprint. Need to pick a contingency for the MVP vs v1 split. Acme pilot + internal launch same week. My proposal: defer embeddings/rerank to v1, keep core chat and promptstore read/write in MVP. Thoughts? :thinking:

john: We're seeing queue saturation when avg seq_len > 1k. If embeddings stay, we get a 3–4x token processing/kv pressure spike. Cost + tail latency both go up. Suggest defer unless Acme contract forces it.

kai: To add context from PM side: Acme really wants ranking for their demo, but contract has language around 'ranking improvements' not strictly embeddings. We could offer a hosted rerank as a temporary workaround.

 sarah: UX call: rerank changes search results ordering. If we delay, we need a clear fallback UX (e.g., "Sort: relevance (beta)") so customers aren't surprised. I can scope a small design for that.

mark: Infra numbers: current steady qps ~1.2k. With embeddings in path, p95 token throughput triples during peak => estimate +3 reserved GPUs for Dedicated which pushes cost up ~30% for that environment. Autoscaler warm-up is ~6m so burst capacity isn't instant.

john: Also note: embedding inference is very batch-friendly, but our current promptstore/cache relies on low-latency KV hits. Mixing both tight latency paths complicates the runtime kernel selection.

lina: Any legal or sales blockers if we defer? Kai?

kai: Sales: Acme will push for the ranking on launch. Legal: no hard SLA written for embedding speed, just expected feature. We can negotiate a 30-day hosted rerank pilot in contract with a note.

john: Hosted rerank works as temporary but latency will be higher; acceptable for demo but not GA. We'll need a feature-flag toggle and throttling on that path.

sarah: If hosted rerank is used, UI must show a "Beta" label and maybe a tooltip explaining variance. I'll design a compact microcopy.

lina: Quick poll — react with :one: to defer embeddings to v1 (hosted temporary), :two: to keep embeddings in MVP (incurs infra uplift).

john: :one:

mark: :one: -- leaning deferral unless Acme insists.

kai: :two: — need to confirm with Acme; if they push we'll evaluate cost tradeoffs.

sarah: :one:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Note added to release board: ticket #PROD-1234 "MVP: embeddings contingency — hosted rerank option" https://redwood.internal/board/PROD-1234

lina: Decision (tentative): Defer embeddings/rerank to v1; offer hosted rerank as stopgap for Acme. Action items:
- kai: confirm Acme acceptance of hosted rerank + timeline (due EoQ?)
- john: implement feature-flag toggle and throttle path; ensure telemetry for quality/regressions
- sarah: design fallback microcopy + beta label; provide 2 small mocks
- mark: update capacity/cost estimate and Dedicated commit impacts

john: Example toggle I'll use (devops):
```bash
# turn embeddings off for MVP rollout
redwoodctl rollout set --feature embeddings --state off --env prod
```

kai: I'll ping Acme and get a written OK by EOD tomorrow. If they insist, we'll reconvene and weigh cost vs contractual risk.

lina: OK — I'll update the roadmap and the launch checklist. Re-open thread if Acme objects or if infra numbers change. :thumbsup:
